power_grid.summary: The US regulator adopted an interventionist stance to accelerate data center grid connections while the Senate advanced a bill requiring data centers to pay for both existing and new grid infrastructure. Major commercial shifts included Microsoft and Chevron signing a 20-year Texas power deal, Torus raising $500 million for prefabricated data centers designed to bypass grid queues, and AZIO AI Holdings planning a Texas data center operating independently of the main grid.
